description: Drainage grips in Devon is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Devon County Council. Drainage grips on the Devon highways network. A highway grip is a shallow ditch connecting the road edge to the roadside ditch. Its purpose is to drain rain water from the highway into the roadside ditch. Coverage: Devon County Council. The portal files it under the publisher Devon County Council. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, XML. The portal shows 2015-07-14 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
